name: fchmodat
synopsis: int fchmodat(int dirfd, const char *pathname, mode_t mode, int flags);
description: fchmodat() changes the mode bits of a file specified by a directory file descriptor and a pathname. It allows for additional flags to control behavior, such as handling symbolic links. This system call is useful for changing permissions relative to an open directory.

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor, or AT_FDCWD to use the current working directory

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Pathname of the file whose mode is to be changed

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The new file mode bits, including permissions and special flags like S_ISUID

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that modify the operation, such as AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied on a component of the path prefix
pathname is relative and dirfd is neither AT_FDCWD nor a valid file descriptor
pathname points outside your accessible address space
Too many symbolic links were encountered in resolving pathname
A component of the path prefix is not a directory, or pathname is relative and dirfd is not a directory
flags specified AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW, which is not supported
The effective UID does not match the owner of the file, or the file is marked immutable
The named file resides on a read-only filesystem
